name: VALENTINES DAY: HAWKS
source:
A short visual novel wherein you and Hawks have been neighbors for several months, and you have finally mustered up the courage to tell him your feelings.

[From [url=https://procrastinationartist.itch.io/valentines-day-hawks]Itch.io[/url]]

在这部短篇视觉小说中，你与霍克斯已经做了几个月的邻居。如今，你终于鼓起勇气，准备向他表明心意。

[摘自[url=https://procrastinationartist.itch.io/valentines-day-hawks]Itch.io[/url]]
